scope: Packet-only content checks; not repository build/tests or live-site verification.
checks: JSON parsing and existing metadata schema
Unique slugs absent from pinned main
Reference existence and metadata citation numbering
EN/ZH section-ID, citation-sequence, and numeral-multiset parity (normalizing level-1 versus Chinese ordinal wording)
English Guide and term length bounds
Chinese full-body presence and English-body language restriction
Metadata relationships target baseline or this packet only
Same-language internal links and in-packet anchors
Formula/adduct arithmetic, ppm error, and tolerance window
Lipid chain-sum arithmetic and explicit evidence boundaries
Mobility time correction, unit conversion, bias, and CCS percent difference
not_run: Existing repository structural and science tests
scientific_review_note: Automated checks verify internal consistency; they do not establish scientific truth or replace expert review.
